title.zh: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports
title.en: Trump is expected to appoint Jay Clayton as new AI czar: Reports

current_state.zh: Trump is expected to name US director of national intelligence Jay Clayton as his new AI czar, a role that would oversee AI innovation and development under a light-regulation, industry self-policing framework, according to CNN and other media reports citing unnamed sources.
